bacaan.teks:
Read the dialogue below for questions number 1 to 5!

Galang : Good morning, Sir. Excuse me, are you Mr. Rahmat, the new English teacher?

Galang : Allow me to introduce myself, Sir. My name is Galang Pratama from Class VII-A. I come from Kalimantan and now I live in SMP Nusantara dormitory. Welcome to our school!
Mr. Rahmat : Thank you, Galang. It’s a pleasure to meet you. By the way, I need to go to the teachers’ office now. See you in class at 9 o’clock.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: He comes from Bali and he is in Class IX-C.

pembahasan: Berdasarkan dialog, Galang menyatakan: "My name is Galang Pratama from Class VII-A. I come from Kalimantan...". Pilihan B tepat.

materi: Grammar Focus: To Be (am, is, are)

bacaan.teks:
Read the recipe below for questions number 26 to 30!

HOW TO MAKE REFRESHING ICED LEMON TEA

Ingredients:
• 2 tea bags of black tea
• 2 cups of boiling water
• 2 tablespoons of honey or organic sugar
• 1 fresh lemon (sliced thinly)
• 6 ice cubes
• Fresh mint leaves (optional for garnish)

Utensils: A glass pitcher, a spoon, a knife, and serving glasses.

Steps:
1. First, brew the 2 tea bags in 2 cups of boiling water inside the pitcher for about 4 minutes until dark amber.
2. Next, remove the tea bags and add 2 tablespoons of honey. Stir well until the honey completely dissolves.
3. After that, squeeze half of the fresh lemon juice into the tea and stir gently.
4. Then, drop the thin lemon slices and ice cubes into the pitcher.
5. Finally, pour the iced lemon tea into serving glasses and garnish with mint leaves. Serve immediately!

opsi_jawaban.label: C

HOW TO MAKE A SELF-WATERING POT FROM USED PLASTIC BOTTLES

Step 1: Cut a clean 1.5-liter plastic bottle horizontally into two halves using scissors.
Step 2: Poke a small drainage hole in the plastic bottle cap and thread a piece of cotton wick/cloth strip through it.
Step 3: Invert the top bottle half (upside down) and place it inside the bottom half filled with water. The wick will absorb water upward.
Step 4: Fill the inverted top section with fertile planting soil and plant your seedling. Water once, and the self-watering system will keep the soil moist automatically.
